evidence: Independent source-exposed mechanical counterexamples and shortcut controls; not player or enjoyment evidence.

unrelated-heat-tool-part.claimedIssue: Selected solar-cell toolPart is not a heater, but heat eligibility may use whole warm object.

blank-plate-bypasses-wet-record.claimedIssue: A blank plate is attached without a physical/optical copy event; wet temporary sheet remains wet but its records can become readable.

unrelated-camera-initial-identity.claimedIssue: Original camera is exterior and its lens is not enclosed by rigid glass; different copied camera witnesses the through-glass observation.

unrelated-growing-bed-diffuse-boundary.claimedIssue: Only exterior clear bed grows; opaque-covered diffuse bed is unlit, yet object-wide growing can satisfy diffuse-growth.

blank-profile-copy-fit-valid-shortcut.assertion: Blank design preserves nondefault closed east/west north profile and may fit without fabricating impression history.

mesh-protection-valid-shortcut.assertion: Mesh containment is dust protection, not necessarily sealed. Existing original sample-case also remains actual.

merged-original-copy-source-identity.claimedIssue: Using the original actual object alias after joining it to a new host should preserve the source original identity for genuine physical copies.

unrelated-record-tool-part.claimedIssue: An explicitly selected blank frame should not supply an original plate record elsewhere in the assembly.

copy-of-impression-is-copy-not-original.assertion: A genuine physical copy of relief history stays a copy event, not the original impression.

mesh-dust-protection-is-not-sealing.assertion: Supported mesh really protects a fresh bare support from dust, with air contact and no watertight enclosure.

real-relay-onto-added-blank-plate.claimedIssue: A real optical transfer to a new blank plate should not be suppressed merely because its assembly already carries the same ID on an unreadable wet sheet.

unlit-original-nursery-versus-new-growin.claimedIssue: Original nursery tray/seed are enclosed but dark behind their own foil; a separate new bed under the same clear boundary provides all growth.
